references.text: The Lord announces that he will perform many signs and wonders in Egypt, which points directly to the fulfillment described in Deuteronomy 34:11
The Lord explains the purpose of the signs and wonders he performs against Pharaoh and Egypt, so that the Israelites may tell future generations about them
Summary that the Lord performed many wonders in Egypt, but Pharaoh hardened his heart and refused to let the people go
Moses reminds the people of the great signs, wonders, and mighty hand God used to deliver them from Egypt
The Lord performed great and terrible signs and wonders against Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his household
Moses recalls the great trials, signs, and wonders that the people themselves witnessed when the Lord brought them out of Egypt
The psalm describes how God set his signs in Egypt and his wonders on the plains of Zoan
The psalm tells how Moses and Aaron performed the Lord's signs and wonders in the land of Ham (Egypt)
Praise to God who sent signs and wonders into the midst of Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants
Jeremiah praises God who performed signs and wonders in Egypt and continued to do so in Israel, leading the people out with a strong hand
Stephen recounts in his speech how Moses led the people out and performed wonders and signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea, and in the wilderness
